BURSEVI:v6p218#3/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p218#3/r7.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p218#3/r7.claim: He commands obedience because the word of a trusted person is reliable.
BURSEVI:v6p218#3/r7.anchor: {فاتقوا الله وأطيعون} فإن قول المؤتمن معتمد.

TAB-FULL:v17p629/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v17p629/r3.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v17p629/r3.claim: Lot urges them to fear punishment for denying His messenger and obey his call so he may guide them to the right path.
TAB-FULL:v17p629/r3.anchor: {فاتقوا الله} [آل عمران: 50] في أنفسكم، أن يحل بكم عقابه على تكذيبكم رسوله {وأطيعون} [آل عمران: 50] فيما دعوتكم إليه أهدكم سبيل الرشاد.

TABATABAI:26:167-175/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:26:167-175/r1.speaker: author
TABATABAI:26:167-175/r1.claim: Al-Tabatabai says Lot's preceding argument rests on a demonstrative proof to which the discussion points, also reflected in the parallel wording cited from al-ʿAnkabut.
TABATABAI:26:167-175/r1.anchor: وقد ظهر من جميع ما مر أن كلامه عليه السلام مبني على حجة برهانية أشير إليها

YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p519/r5.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p519/r5.speaker: author
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p519/r5.claim: Lot asks no payment; his reward is recompense from the Lord of the worlds.
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p519/r5.anchor: إن ثوابي. {إلا على رب العالمين {164} أتأتون الذكران من العالمين {165}

ELMALILI:26:160-175/r2.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:26:160-175/r2.speaker: author
ELMALILI:26:160-175/r2.claim: He urges them to fear God and obey him.
ELMALILI:26:160-175/r2.anchor: Gelin Allah’tan korkun da bana itaat edin (163).

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p440/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p440/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p440/r1.claim: The opening messenger appeal and command to fear God and obey Lot recur in earlier anecdotes and were explained there.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p440/r1.anchor: These verses occur in the previous anecdotes also. They have been explained there.

NASHR:v2p336/r10.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p336/r10.speaker: يعقوب
NASHR:v2p336/r10.claim: Yaqub affirms the sixteen listed extra yāʾs in both connected and pause forms: the eight quoted forms plus أطيعون in eight places.
NASHR:v2p336/r10.anchor: أثبت الياء في جميعها يعقوب في الحالين

QIRAAT-ER:26:163:5#1/r1.author: QIRAAT-ER
QIRAAT-ER:26:163:5#1/r1.speaker: author
QIRAAT-ER:26:163:5#1/r1.claim: The added final yāʾ restores the fuller -nī pronoun form and lengthens the ending.
QIRAAT-ER:26:163:5#1/r1.anchor: Addition of final yāʾ to the first-person pronoun — wa-aṭīʿūnī with long ī at end

BIQAI-FULL:v5p382/r21.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p382/r21.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p382/r21.claim: Fear God because He can destroy whom He wills; obey Lot because obedience brings safety and he commands only what God approves.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p382/r21.anchor: أي لقدرته على إهلاك من يريد وتعاليه في عظمته

IBNABIHATIM:v9p2808/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2808/r1.speaker: عطاء
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2808/r1.claim: Ata says obeying the messenger means following the Book and the Sunna.
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2808/r1.anchor: عن عطاء قوله : واطيعون قال : طاعة الرسول

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p240#3/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p240#3/r2.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p240#3/r2.claim: The yāʾ is shortened in spelling and pronunciation to match the verse endings.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p240#3/r2.anchor: واختصرت الياء في الخط واللفظ من قوله وأطيعون مراعاة لرؤوس الآي أن تتناسب

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p157#2/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p157#2/r3.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p157#2/r3.claim: Lūṭ called his people to worship God alone, obey the messenger sent to them, and avoid disobeying God.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p157#2/r3.anchor: فدعاهم إلى الله، عز وجل، أن يعبدوه وحده لا شريك له، وأن يطيعوا رسولهم

MUQATIL:26:160-173/r5.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:26:160-173/r5.speaker: author
MUQATIL:26:160-173/r5.claim: Lot calls them to worship God and follow his counsel.
